notes.title: The Skeleton 0.2 Update
notes.notes:
The Skeleton Game has finally been updated. This update has many changes added to the game.

- Story Mode is currently unavailable for fixes and newly added content.
- How to play section shows you how to play the Survival Maps, Game Modes, Special Maps and even how to use your controls.
- Survival Maps' timer is now in minutes instead of seconds.
- Health Bar has been added.
- When hit by the Skeleton, there is blood on the screen that appears.
- The Game now has a shotgun and a pistol for Survival maps and game modes but they are hidden throughout the map and the player must find them or survive the timer like last time. 
- The Skeleton can now go indoors to houses.
- There is a new Special Map called "The Skyscraper". The player has to find the gun in one of the cubicles of the office while the Skeleton is hunting them. The Skeleton is slower and there is no timer but you have to keep moving or else he will catch you.
- The Special Map "I Dare you to press this button has been changed to "The Maze" and you have to go through the map to find the exit while getting hunted down by the Skeletons.
- The Labyrinth map has been extended and has jail cells.
- 2 new houses have been added to The Streets map. Before there was a big open field with nothing there.
- A new building has been added in "The City" map.
- The Options menu has underwent a few changes.
- The Game over scenes and the Victory scenes have been updated with props in them.
- Party Time!!!! got a few new additions.
- Small bug fixes

[b]KNOWN BUGS:
*If you pick up the weapon and pause the game then click within the pause menu, the gun can still be fired. Until I can find a way to fix this, you can hit Esc on your keyboard and you will be brought back to the game.*
*The Skeleton still moves while being shot*
*There is some places in the maps where the Skeleton can't reach you*
*When you go back to the main menu after being in a match, the rain is quieter in the menu*[/b]

I will do the best I can do have more updates in the future. I figured since the game hasn't had any updates for a long time that I would just update what I got and fix things afterwards. I still plan to improve!

Thanks for playing!
